title: The Dock
text: Neon on wet concrete. The boats knock together. Somewhere above, a Meridian drone crosses and does not stop.

places.label: Marcus's Booth
places.text: Marcus is always here. He does not do the work. He makes it possible.

places.label: The Fence
places.text: Cash, no questions. Prices are on the wall.

places.label: The Clinic
places.text: Dr. Kahale's cousin. Clean enough. She does not ask.

places.label: The Mirasol
places.text: Reyes's boat. She is leaking again.

lines.heard-rats: You heard the rats before you met them.
lines.rite-said: You said the engineer's phrase. The custodians are stood down.
lines.guardian-stilled: The Moray stood down for the lamp.
lines.guardian-fed: You fed the Moray and it let you by.
lines.guardian-passed: You passed the Moray without a fight.
lines.guardian-freed: You broke the leash. The Moray went north and has not come back.
lines.have-cores: You have the four cold cores.
lines.has-ledger: You hold the Kelp Line's ledger.
lines.boat-cut: The Kelp Line's boat is adrift.
lines.alarmed: The Kelp Line knows you came.
lines.vault-seen: You have seen the vault door.
lines.vault-tried: The Algorithm spoke once, and filed you.
lines.employer-pinged: Ann's old employer knows where she was.
lines.on-stream: Reiko's feed has the whole fight.
lines.on-record: The Kelp Line has Reiko's face on record.
lines.favour-called: Rook called a favor on Marcus.
lines.lamp-sold: You sold the Green Lamp to Rook.
